label: Chogchemy house style
description: A provisional style until our artist supplies reference drawings.
rules: Create one new, coherent Chog-inspired creature, rather than two characters beside each other.
Inherit recognizable shape, facial features, colors, and accessories from both parents in roughly equal measure.
Use expressive comic linework, a clean silhouette, flat colors, and gentle cel shading.
Center the full character on a simple warm cream background with enough room around its silhouette.
No captions, logos, signatures, watermarks, panels, or additional characters.
